title: Gate closed: cross-wing hand-over (cloud decision)
note: Cloud-level decision test. A ward-3 (shared) delivery is leased to the EAST wing, then a CLOSED-GATE UNEXPECTED_EVENT is reported over the edge escalation HTTP contract; we read how each config's cloud reaction (react.py) resolves it. C1/C2 run the cloud LLM agent, which can choose `hand_over` -> reassign to the west wing in one step. C3 runs the RULES fallback, which has no hand_over verb: it tries `replan` (same wing, which fails here) and only reaches the hand-over as a replan_failed -> reassign fallback, or alerts an operator. At this one-shot decision C1 and C2 use the same agent and are close; C2's extra cost is the per-step relay round trips during execution, which this test does not exercise. The hand-over is reported to the cloud over HTTP rather than by a kinematic robot, because the kinematic mock robot does not block arbitrary corridors; this isolates the cloud DECISION. Local cloud, as T2/T4 (a managed endpoint can't host the forced closure + fleet control); T1/T8 use the deployed endpoints.
